title: Nonjunction cancellation in the first Cech sorting boundary
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $I$ a linearly ordered type, $U:I\to\operatorname{Opens}(X)$,
$F:\operatorname{Opens}(X)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ a presheaf, and $S$ a
SiteCechComplex for the arrows $U_i\to X$ [def-pc-scheme, def-sc-zariski-site,
def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Let $p\ge0$, $s$ a cochain in degree $p+1$,
and $t:\operatorname{Fin}(p+2)\to I$. Use stable sorting, partial sorting and
junction maps from [def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators]. For permutations
$\sigma,\tau$ of $\operatorname{Fin}(p+2)$, $a\in\operatorname{Fin}(p+2)$ and
$r\in\operatorname{Fin}(p+3)$, write $q=\operatorname{cechJunction}(\sigma,\tau,a)$,
$\delta_r=r.\operatorname{succAbove}$, and define
$E_{\sigma,a,\tau,r}=(-1)^a\operatorname{sign}(\tau)\,
 F(\operatorname{indexMap}(t,q))((-1)^r
 F(\operatorname{indexMap}(t\circ q,\delta_r))(s((t\circ q)\circ\delta_r)))$,
with contravariant restriction maps. Sum only over pairs for which $\sigma$
is the stable sort of $t$ and $\tau$ fixes its prefix below $a$ and has an
increasing tail starting at $a$. The sum $N$ of these terms with $q(r)\ne\sigma(a)$ satisfies
$N+(d^p(H_p(s)))(t)=0$, where $H_p$ is the explicit first sorting homotopy.

source.place: Tag 01FM, cohomology-equation-first-homotopy (20.23.6.1), omitted verification of dh+hd; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01FM

proof.text: Define V(alpha) to be the restriction of s(t composed with alpha) to the intersection for t. Index-map composition holds because scheme opens form a thin category. Functoriality therefore identifies each nested restriction in the outgoing and incoming expansions with V of the composite label map. Homomorphisms preserve integer multiples.

Partition outgoing nonjunction terms by r<a and its negation. Partition incoming terms according to whether the deleted labelled pair (t(j),j) precedes the face junction labelled pair. Distribute the finite sums. Apply the prefix labelled-deletion cancellation to V.

Apply the tail labelled-deletion cancellation to V. Add the two zero identities and rearrange the four sums in the abelian group. The two incoming parts are exactly the defining expansion of the differential of the first homotopy. This proves the original nonjunction identity, with no change to its hypotheses or conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem cechFirstSortingNonjunctionCancellation (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v} [LinearOrder I]
    (U : I → X.Opens) (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤)))
    (p : ℕ) (s : S.cochains F (p + 1)) (t : Fin (p + 2) → I) :
    let E := fun (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (a : Fin (p + 2))
        (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (r : Fin (p + 3)) ↦
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ)) •
        F.map (S.indexMap t (cechJunction σ τ a)).op
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val •
            F.map (S.indexMap (t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) r.succAbove).op
              (s ((t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) ∘ r.succAbove)))
    (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2)), ∑ a : Fin (p + 2),
      ∑ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2)), ∑ r : Fin (p + 3),
        if (cechStableSort t σ ∧ cechPartialSort σ τ a) ∧
            cechJunction σ τ a r ≠ σ a then E σ a τ r else 0) +
      (S.differential F p (cechFirstSortingHom X U F S p s)) t = 0
